title: Lenticular
description: A 1960s flicker card: ridged plastic laminated over a 1909 baseball card. Tilt it and each lenticule shows a different interlaced frame, so Mathewson winds up and throws right there in the plastic.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: the view angle through each ridge picks the frame, so the motion lives in the lens, with the banding, ghosting and sheen of a cheap Vari-Vue card.
